original: You made it! Step in and cover the west side!
translation: 你活下来了！进来，守住西面！

original: Radiations are still too high, sir.
No! Sir, we see a lot of undead movement. Shit! It didn't work! It didn't work!
translation: 不！长官，我们发现大量尸群在移动。该死！没用！根本没用！

original: Sir, we're being overrun! Mitch, hold that door! We're not gonna last much! Hold that door! Mitch! Fuck!
translation: 长官，我们顶不住了！米奇，守住那扇门！撑不了多久了！守住门！米奇！操！

original: General! I lost contact with most of my men. We have a downtown crowd coming east.
translation: 将军！我和大部分人失联了。市中心有一大群人正往东涌来。

original: And an army coming west from Senoia. And massive fires raging through the city.
translation: 还有一支大军从塞诺亚往西推进。大火正在城里蔓延。
杰克逊！五个！九点钟方向！

original: Seems like a great time to get the hell out of here, sir. What are your orders?
translation: 长官，这真是开溜的好时候。请下命令。

original: Yes, sir! Come on! Come on! We're moving out!
